description: Lists the points and datasheet updates the installed army data recorded, newest first, as the /data-updates pages show them. Each update has its UTC time, url, total change count and omitted (changes past its stored bound). Without faction, each update lists only the factions it reached with their change counts. With faction, it lists that faction's changes in groups: kind (datasheet-points, datasheet-added, datasheet-removed, detachment-points, detachment-added, detachment-removed, enhancement-points, enhancement-added, enhancement-removed), name, points from and to (per models row for datasheets; null where none), and the url of the page describing it now, or null when it no longer exists. Pass older as before for the next page; null means no older updates.

before.description: The older cursor from a previous page; omit for the newest updates.

faction.description: A faction slug from list_factions, such as necrons, to list only the updates that reached that faction.

name: list_data_updates
title: List game-data updates
